Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the lines $y=x+6,$ $y=2x,$ and $y=3x,$ as shown in the picture. Express the double integral of the function $f(x,y)$ over the region $D$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.

feedback.problem:
Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curves $y={2}^{x},$ $y=\sqrt{x}$  and lines $y=1$ and $y=6-x.$
Express ${∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.
feedback.worked_solution:
First, let's write our equations in terms of $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}y={2}^{x} & \,⟹\,x={log}_{2}⁡y \\ y=\sqrt{x} & \,⟹\,x={y}^{2} \\ y=6-x & \,⟹\,x=6-y\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, let's sketch our region.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/fe95bc4ca8c687c79fe1c475eb1d8001d71a41ba34e076ad7fdfa8391cb08839.png)

   

The region $D$ can be partitioned into two type II regions ${D}_{1}$ and ${D}_{2},$ as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14070962/assets/099c35cbab4dfdd4a94207ed950fbdca8b8e766a612fb5e665e7d443d75ec050.png)

As a result, we get

$$
{D}_{1}={(x,y)\,:\,1\le y\le 2,\,{log}_{2}⁡y\le x\le {y}^{2}}
$$

and 

$$
{D}_{2}={(x,y)\,:\,2\le y\le 4,\,{log}_{2}⁡y\le x\le 6-y}.
$$

Therefore, using the additivity property of double integrals, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,dA & ={∬}_{{D}_{1}}f(x,y)\,dA+{∬}_{{D}_{2}}f(x,y)\,dA \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{{log}_{2}⁡y}^{{y}^{2}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y+{\int }_{2}^{4}{\int }_{{log}_{2}⁡y}^{6-y}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.\end{aligned}
$$
